skill.summary: Free version — generate optimized Amazon listings with titles, bullets, and backend keywords from your product info.

latestVersion.changelog:
Ecommerce Listing Optimizer Lite 1.0.0

- Initial release: generate optimized Amazon product listings from product name, features, and target audience
- Outputs include title, 5 benefit-driven bullet points, a sales-focused description, and backend keywords
- Follows Amazon-specific formatting and character limits
- Free lite version covers Amazon only; directions to upgrade for multi-market support
